title: Establishment of Cooperative Election Authority for Free & Fair Elections
summary: Mandates the Central Government to establish the Cooperative Election Authority (CEA) to conduct elections for the board of multi-state cooperative societies in an impartial and timely manner.
key_provisions: Elections must be held before the expiry of the term of the existing board.
Voters list must be finalized 30 days prior to voting date.
Any member with at least 1 year active membership and required minimum transactions has voting right.
applicable_to: All Multi-State Cooperative Societies across India

section: Section 84 - Reference of Disputes to Arbitration
title: Dispute Resolution & Arbitration Procedure
summary: Provides the statutory mechanism for settling disputes concerning the constitution, management, elections or business of a cooperative society through the Central Registrar or appointed Arbitrator.
key_provisions: Disputes between members, past members, or society and board must be referred to arbitration.
Civil courts have barred jurisdiction over matters covered under Section 84.
Limitation period for monetary claims is 3 years from cause of action.

act_name: Model State Cooperative Societies Act & State Cooperative Bylaws
section: Section 19 / Rule 12 - Right to Membership & Non-Discrimination
title: Right of Eligible Farmers to Obtain PACS Membership
summary: Every eligible farmer or rural artisan residing within the operational area of a Primary Agricultural Credit Society (PACS) has an open right to membership upon paying prescribed share capital.
key_provisions: PACS Managing Committee cannot reject membership without written justification within 30 days.
If not communicated in 30 days, deemed membership applies or appeal lies to Assistant Registrar (ARCS).
Nominal/Associate members cannot vote, but full members enjoy complete democratic voting rights.
citations: Model State Cooperative Societies Bylaws Cl. 7
